node.title: Re^2: Perl 5.12.2 Data Structures
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [hennesse],

Many of the examples in the 5.24 perldsc just do not work.

... there seems to have been a lot of changes since 5.12

There have been a few changes since v5.12 (for example, the addition of the [doc://perlref#Postfix-Dereference-Syntax] and [doc://perldata#Key/Value-Hash-Slices], and for a while there was the experimental and now-removed [doc://perlexperiment#Array-and-hash-container-functions-accept-references|"autoderef"] feature), but as far as I can remember they've all been backwards compatible (and [doc://perldsc] hasn't had any significant changes in the code examples for 15 years). Could you point out the examples in [doc://perldsc] that don't work for you?

Thanks,
-- Hauke D
